newsitem.title: GERMANY: JAL adds fourth Frankfurt-Osaka flight.
newsitem.headline: JAL adds fourth Frankfurt-Osaka flight.

text.p: Japan Air Lines said it will add a fourth weekly Frankfurt to Osaka flight from April 6.
Germany passenger sales manager Jochen Niemann told Reuters the additional flight would give JAL 11 weekly flights from Germany.
The fourth McDonnell Douglas MD-11 Osaka nonstop flights came on top of daily Boeing 747-400 nonstop flights to Tokyo, he said.
In comparison, Deutsche Lufthansa AG has 16 weekly services, including its new destination of Nagoya, and All Nippon Airways flies five times a week to Tokyo.
Niemann said JAL passenger numbers from Germany were good with strong growth in the vital business travel segment last year but yields were slightly down.
The number of German visitors to Japan should have topped 70,000 last year after a rise of 5.6 percent to more than 68,000 in 1995, he added.
